text: Underway in this RFL clash!
Flash immediately signals a rapid push forward.
Tortoise has hit the deck without anyone near them, gyros whirring as they begin the self-righting routine in midfield.
Spark bursts down the right flank, clean through with an open goal ahead!
Spark drives down the wing.
Rebounded hard off the corner panel!
Gemini Flash are applying heavy pressure, hemming Fable deep in their end.
Just wide of the post!
Comical scenes as the two electric blue teammates crash straight into each other!
Another collision between Spark and Flash—total miscommunication in the blue ranks as Spark hits the turf.
Flash puts in a firm challenge, sending Tortoise clattering to the floor in Fable's defensive third.
The teammates collide once again!
Flash clatters Tortoise down again.
Spark urges an immediate attack.
The corner push-panel launches the ball back into play.
Spark steps in heavily and sends Hare sprawling to the deck.
Hare recovers and levels Flash right on the goal line with a crunching block!
Tortoise loses balance again in defence, toppling over with those servomotors working overtime to reset.
Hare makes another decisive intervention, bowling Flash over just two metres from goal to snuff out the danger.
Now Hare takes an unprompted tumble on the right channel, joining Tortoise in the self-righting club.
Agonisingly close as the ball drifts inches past the terracotta target!
Hare goes down again on the right side. Not quite the nimble start AFC Fable might have hoped for, but they are getting back up.
Flashed just wide from point-blank range!
Tortoise clips the ball forward into open space—there is nobody back to defend!
Tortoise signals to take things steady and methodical on the left flank, true to their namesake as they advance.
GOAL! Hare pounces right on the goal mouth and slots it home! The terracotta shirts take the lead, Gemini Flash FC nil, AFC Fable one!
Hare breaks away through the middle, utterly clear of the electric blue defence!
A rasping effort whistles just half a metre wide of the upright.
Tortoise communicates to keep the tempo controlled from the back.
GOAL! Hare strikes again, drilling it home from two metres out! It is a double for Hare, and AFC Fable lead two-nil!
Hare drives centrally towards goal.
Centimetres away from a hat-trick as Hare's shot skims the post!
Spark attempts to relieve the pressure, carrying the ball three metres out from the defensive third.
A looping effort on the right channel drifts just wide of the mark.
GOAL! A disastrous own goal by Spark! AFC Fable lead three-nil right before the break!
Hare signals ruthless attacking intent.
That brings a commanding first half to a close. AFC Fable hold a handsome three-nil lead over a rattled Gemini Flash side.
Inches away from a fourth as the shot shaves the outer paint!
Fable are completely dominant now, pinning Gemini Flash deep in their own territory.
Spark lands a heavy tackle on Hare to halt the charge on the right.
Another sighter from distance flashes just wide of the net.
GOAL! Tortoise bundles it over from point-blank range! Slow and steady does it, and AFC Fable make it four-nil!
Hare radios that they are fully alert and ready to keep pressing the advantage.
Hare charges straight through midfield!
GOAL! Hare finishes it with authority from two metres! A magnificent hat-trick, and AFC Fable are running riot at five-nil!
Tortoise breaks clean through from midfield—the entire blue defence has vanished!
Tortoise charges right to the net!
Deflected away off the post!
GOAL! Flash deflects it in! Another own goal makes it six-nil to AFC Fable!
Tortoise reminds their partner that methodical play is paying huge dividends out here today.
With time running down, Tortoise is clean through again!
Tortoise gallops eight metres along the left wing.
Fired just wide of goal!
GOAL! Tortoise tucks it away on the rebound from point-blank range! Under two minutes left and it is Gemini Flash nil, AFC Fable seven!
Hare strides down the left flank.
Fable maintain total territorial control.
Narrowly past the post!
Spark calls out desperately to finish any rare opportunity that comes their way, with barely ninety seconds remaining.
Fable camp inside the final third once more.
GOAL! An absolute nightmare for Flash, turning it into their own net again! It is Gemini Flash nil, AFC Fable eight in the final minute!
Spark drives up the left in search of consolation.
Spark sends a shot skimming past the post—nothing is going right for Gemini Flash today.
GOAL! Flash scores yet another own goal in the dying seconds! A staggering nine-nil to AFC Fable!
Full time: Gemini Flash nil, AFC Fable nine. Next up, Synthetic Athletic face Manus FC!
